hakkindaPage.title: About
hakkindaPage.metaDescription: What is carsbid.lol and how does it work?
hakkindaPage.p1: carsbid.lol is a for-fun popularity contest between car models sold in {country}. The model year doesn't matter — whether it's a Fiat Egea, Toyota Corolla, or Tesla Model 3, you're voting for the nameplate alone.
hakkindaPage.p2: Every model can have a patron: a small ad slot shown on that model's page. Anyone who wants to become the patron bids above the current price (Take Over) to claim the slot and showcase their own social account — Instagram, TikTok, X, YouTube, or a website — to that model's fans.
hakkindaPage.p3: This project is inspired by memleket.lol: we apply the same "vote, push to the top, take over the ad slot" mechanic to car models instead of cities.
hakkindaPage.p4: Patron payments are securely processed through Lemon Squeezy; vote and visit counts are tracked server-side in real time.

kurallarPage.title: Rules
kurallarPage.rule1Body: You can vote once per model from one device. Your vote is reflected in the ranking instantly.
kurallarPage.rule2Body: It doesn't matter which model year it is — 'Corolla' is a single option, not split into 2020 vs. 2024.
kurallarPage.rule3Body: To take over a model's ad slot, bid above the current price. When a new bid comes in, the previous patron drops into the 'Previous Patrons' list.
kurallarPage.rule4Body: You can showcase your Instagram, TikTok, X, YouTube account, or a website. Misleading, illegal, or hateful content is not accepted.
kurallarPage.rule5Body: Patron payments are processed through Lemon Squeezy. Once a payment is confirmed, the patron assignment updates instantly server-side.
